WAB_2012_p76__paragraph_0.ocr:
The assumed health care cost trend rate for the U.S. plans grades from an initial rate of 7.2% to an ultimate
rate of 4.5% by 2027 and for international plans from 8.0% to 4.5% by 2030. A 1% increase in the assumed
health care cost trend rate will increase the service and interest cost components of the expense recognized for
the U.S. and international postretirement plans by approximately $180,000 and $22,000, respectively, for 2013,
and increase the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation by approximately $4.4 million and $324,000,
respectively. A 1% decrease in the assumed health care cost trend rate will decrease the service and interest cost
components of the expense recognized for the U.S. and international postretirement plans by approximately
$153,000 and $18,000, respectively, for 2013, and decrease the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation by
approximately $3.7 million and $279,000, respectively.
